scope: step 3: introduced-species dispatch becomes C++ overrides on the step-2 classes and exact qualified direct calls; bodies stay where they are (step 4 moves them)

rules.override_home: an override stands on the class that introduces the body: the topmost class of the census chain holding the same body at that slot (overrides-step3.tsv port_class); descendants inherit it
rules.forwarding: a forwarding override may call the existing FElysiumNpc body until step 4 moves it; the overlay target keeps naming the body's definition. A body converted in place is retargeted
rules.direct_calls: a species body's call to what it replaces is qualified to the recovered callee owner: Troika -> FElysiumNpc::X, an intermediate species -> FElysiumNpc<Parent>::X, CAI_BaseNPC -> the distinct existing base helper (renamed in step 5, step5_renames). Nested virtual calls stay virtual
rules.guard: SpeciesDispatchingSlot / FSpeciesDispatchScope emulate retail's non-virtual call into the replaced body; a qualified call replaces them and they go with their last introduced consumer
rules.mixed_sites: an address shared by introduced and deferred classes becomes the introduced override; the table/arm keeps only its deferred rows as a surviving site with its fold step
rules.tables: a slot-keyed species table is a set of retail override bodies and becomes overrides; a class-keyed data query stays with a named consumer; a test-only table is retired with its tests re-pinned on real factories, or kept as census with its consumer
rules.type_tests: a retail-class test on this that selects behaviour is dispatch (override); a retail type test on another entity keeps a typed check through Other->RetailClass() (answered by the C++ type) or a classname compare where retail compares names; no RTTI
rules.residue: a retail body with no port implementation stays a live unported rule; step 3 does not port new behaviour, except the one-byte vocal bodies the spec's vocalisation job names
rules.registry_constants: a registry: constant row (GOverrides.Default) has no production reader; it is not dispatch and moves as a body in step 4
